note: Il2CppType array in the 7.0.0 module, located by a structure scan (16-byte records with a valid Il2CppTypeEnum byte and small attrs) and validated against three independent tables: every field/method/param type index is < count, and the method return column resolves to 61% System.Void.
note_kinds: 0x11 VALUETYPE and 0x12 CLASS store a TypeDefinitionIndex in data; 0x15 GENERICINST stores a generic-instance index; 0x13/0x1E are VAR/MVAR (generic parameter position); 0x1D SZARRAY / 0x0F PTR store an element type index or pointer (unresolved).
